_about: Each resident's portrait for the Haven window's People page (Tools/LocalSpawn/generate_ui_art.py residents, 768x768 saved at 512), keyed by their ResidentDefinition asset's name. Head and shoulders, three-quarter view, in plain Norse working clothes with the tools of their trade, from their role and their voice's description (Tools/Audio/dialogue_voices.py), against a soft blurred background of the Haven.
Sigrid: Head and shoulders portrait of a Norse woman in her forties, the leader of an expedition: a weathered, calm and resolute face, dark blond hair in a practical braid with a few grey strands, a fur-trimmed travelling cloak with a bronze brooch, a sword hilt at her shoulder.
Eirik: Head and shoulders portrait of a Norse man in his late forties, an old soldier: a gruff weathered face with a short greying beard and an old scar across one eyebrow, a dented iron helmet under his arm, mail shirt under a worn leather coat, a dry half smile.
Runa: Head and shoulders portrait of a young Norse woman in her twenties, a tracker and hunter: alert green eyes, freckles, auburn hair tied back with a leather thong, a hooded green wool cloak, a bow over her shoulder and a feather in her hair.
Ingrid: Head and shoulders portrait of a Norse woman in her fifties, an alchemist: a thin, thoughtful, tired face, grey-streaked hair pinned up, a dark wool dress with an apron stained with herbs, small glass vials on a cord around her neck.
Bjarne: Head and shoulders portrait of a big Norse man in his forties, a blacksmith: broad shoulders, a kind face with a thick brown beard, soot on his cheeks, a heavy leather apron, a smith's hammer resting on his shoulder, warm forge light.
Tor: Head and shoulders portrait of an older Norse man in his sixties, a carpenter: a gentle, patient face with a white beard and laugh lines, a wool cap, a carpenter's pencil behind his ear and a wood plane in his hands, wood shavings on his tunic.
Liv: Head and shoulders portrait of a young Norse woman in her late twenties, a scholar of runes: sharp bright eyes, dark hair cut short at the jaw, ink-stained fingers holding a small carved rune stick, a scholar's dark blue cloak with silver rune embroidery.
Asa: Head and shoulders portrait of a Norse woman in her thirties, a farmer: a sturdy, sunburnt, friendly face, straw-blond hair under a linen headscarf, a plain brown dress with rolled sleeves, a pouch of seed and a sheaf of barley.
Gunnar: Head and shoulders portrait of a Norse man in his fifties, a lone hunter: a lean, wary, weathered face, a grizzled beard, a wolf-fur hood, a hunting knife and a coil of snare wire at his belt.
Hild: Head and shoulders portrait of a Norse woman in her forties, a stonemason: strong arms, a blunt, confident face with a raised eyebrow, dark hair tied up in a scarf, stone dust on her clothes, a mason's chisel and mallet.
Yrsa: Head and shoulders portrait of an older Norse woman in her sixties, a proud cook: a round, rosy, lively face, silver hair in a bun, a flour-dusted apron over a red wool dress, a big wooden ladle in her hand, steam from a pot.
